name: release-flow
description: Branching, merge, release, and dev-sync workflow skills for any repo — reads the branch model from the consumer's `.claude/ai-ops.yml` (gitflow, main-only, versioned-gitflow, or custom) and resolves base/release_base from config, falling back to branch detection. Branching/merge/release are applied-repo seams: when `branching.release_skill` is set the loop delegates the cut/bump/tag/back-merge mechanics to it and only orchestrates + gates. Bundles release-and-branching, sync-dev (the dev-sync/back-merge/cleanup contract — no engine bash), and auto-release-loop (issue+label-triggered release, two automated gates — green CI + an Opus pre-publish review against a repo-overridable checklist — no approval pause, Claude push notifications).
